```python
def _submit_in_caller_context(
    pool: ThreadPoolExecutor,
    executor: RouteExecutor,
    request: ResolvedRequest,
    left: threading.Event,
) -> Future[LLMRouterResponse]:
    """Submit one timed attempt to its pool, run in a copy of the caller's context.

    A worker thread starts with an empty context, so without the copy the tracing
    span, the log fields and every other context variable the caller set would not
    reach the attempt; ``asyncio.to_thread`` carries them over the same way.
    """
    return pool.submit(
        contextvars.copy_context().run, executor.execute, request, left=left
    )
```
